Head of Product — Series B consumer-credit fintech, London.

Flexa Money (London, ~60 people, Series B led by Accel, 4x YoY revenue growth) builds a BNPL card for near-prime UK customers. We're hiring our first Head of Product to own the product org: 3 PMs, reporting to the CEO (ex-founder, still close to product). You'll own the credit-card surface end to end — pricing experiments, underwriting flows, activation. Hybrid: 2 days/week in our London Bridge office. We want someone who has shipped consumer-credit product at growth stage and can be the most technical product person in the room.

label.edge_note: bonus criteria match but role_fit already 3; cap makes it a no-op
